assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
medically necessary to address the documented recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and transient cerebral ischemic attacks
